name: TVHplayer
tagline: A desktop client for Tvheadend for watching and recording live TV channels
blurb: TVHplayer is a desktop client for Tvheadend, allowing you to watch and record TV channels from your Tvheadend server.
description:
TVHplayer is a desktop client for Tvheadend, allowing you to watch and record TV channels from your Tvheadend server.

Features include:

• Watch live TV

• Record TV shows directly on the server

• Record streams locally to your computer

• View EPG (Electronic Program Guide) data

• Monitor server status and signal quality

• Support for multiple TVHeadend servers

• Cross-platform: runs on GNU/Linux, Windows and MacOS

For more information, and instructions for setting up your own server please visit Tvheadend official website.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
